description: Universal Bokahli reasoning capability. Byte-identical for all three agents. Adapter only: Bokahli is external and is never modified from here.

defaults.escalation: requires explicit route authority on the work order

invariants: the requested model and the served model are recorded separately
there is no silent fallback: a different served model is reported, never hidden
an unobservable served model is UNKNOWN, never OK
unavailability is reported honestly as UNAVAILABLE
the caller may not select an unrestricted model or tool
